drums.description: Boom bap hip hop, A dry, acoustic drum kit plays a swung breakbeat with a prominent, slightly muffled kick and a crisp snare, A deep, sub-heavy electric bass guitar follows a syncopated two-bar loop, A high-pitched, filtered synthesizer lead plays a repetitive, staccato melodic motif, A vinyl crackle texture persists throughout the arrangement, 92 BPM, G Minor, 4/4 Publish
